notes: kb/Work PB5678: CONFORMS. The intermediate result item of a MOVE to two or more receivers (SendingValueTemp.Materialize) took the sender's edit mask and so edited an alphanumeric-edited or national-edited sender a second time; SendingValueTemp.OfPlace now describes it as the unedited item of the sender's category, usage and length. At --std 2002 MOVE SXE (PIC XBX "A B") TO RX RX2 gives [A B  ][A B  ], PIC X/X "A/B" gives [A/B  ][A/B  ], PIC NBN N"C D" to two national receivers gives [C D  ][C D  ] (GR1: the content moves to each receiver).
